title: Hurricane outer bands: sustained gales over South Florida
text: Sustained tropical-storm-force winds and bands of heavy rain are moving across Miami-Dade. Storm surge models are being updated every hour. Residents in surge-prone A-E zones should monitor evacuation orders.

title: Coastal surge window: 36–48h along Biscayne corridor
text: Based on the current track, peak surge could coincide with high astronomical tide. Impact is expected in 40 hours. Utilities and hospitals are pre-staging backup power. This follows the same cyclone system already producing gales in the region—do not treat as a separate event.
summary: Linked surge risk following active tropical conditions.

title: Civic calendar: port cargo slowdown during weather watch
text: PortMiami is operating under reduced gantry speed due to wind limits. This is a logistics update only; no safety incidents reported.

event_chain_label: MMR: monsoon burst → creek / tide flood stress
title: Monsoon burst: very heavy rain over MMR, rail delays widespread
text: IMD radar shows intense convection over the metropolitan region. Waterlogging is reported on the WEH and in low-lying Wards. BMC has opened war-room staffing. The situation is ongoing; shelters are on standby.
summary: Active monsoon flooding in Mumbai MMR.

event_chain_label: MMR: monsoon burst → creek / tide flood stress
title: Urban flood plume: creek levels may breach tomorrow morning
text: Hydrology teams expect compound flooding where sustained rain meets high tide. Peak stress is expected in 28 hours, downstream of the same monsoon cell already saturating catchments. Focus on Mithi and Dahisar systems.
summary: Forecast flood peak linked to current monsoon burst.
source: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (Disaster Cell)

title: IT sector: optional work-from-home through weekend
text: Major technology parks have encouraged optional remote work while transport stabilizes. No regulatory mandate.

event_chain_label: Jabodetabek: prolonged rain → dam-release flood wave
title: Jabodetabek: hours of continuous rainfall, several rivers at alert
text: Peripheral rainfall is feeding the Ciliwung and Sunter catchments. Pumps in Kelapa Gading and Muara Baru are running at high duty cycle. The episode is still unfolding; residents should avoid wading in brown water.
summary: Ongoing flood risk in Greater Jakarta.

event_chain_label: Jabodetabek: prolonged rain → dam-release flood wave
title: Upstream dam release: flood wave possible within 32 hours
text: Citarum headwater controls will release a timed pulse to protect structural integrity, following the same prolonged rain that is already straining low-lying districts. Affected plumes may reach Cengkareng and coastal kampungs.
summary: Dam release flood linked to ongoing rain.
source: Ministry of Public Works — Water Resources

title: Jakarta: toll road speed limits during standing water
text: Jasa Marga has reduced night-time speed on inner ring segments where visual lane marking is poor. Commuters should use alternate exits.

event_chain_label: Sydney basin: fire weather → ember / growth-corridor risk
title: Bushfire smoke and heat: RFS elevated readiness across Sydney basin
text: West-northwesterly winds are drying fuels west of the divide. A network of back-burns is suspended. The episode is classed as an ongoing heat and smoke day with spot fires possible.

event_chain_label: Sydney basin: fire weather → ember / growth-corridor risk
title: Suburban ember-attack risk: 18–30h window, western growth corridors
text: Shower activity is not expected to penetrate west of the divide before tomorrow night. This secondary risk is tied to the same heat airmass already producing severe fire weather today—not an independent event.
summary: Secondary ember risk window linked to current fire weather.

title: Harbourside schools: air quality index messaging
text: Principals have been advised to limit vigorous outdoor play when AQI exceeds 150. Parents notified via standard SMS tree.

title: Death toll in prior season storm reviewed by state inquiry
text: Officials confirmed 47 indirect fatalities in last season's hurricane, mostly from post-storm power outages. Recovery grants remain open through Q3. This is a post-event review; no active landfall in this bulletin.

title: Seismic Watch: High-pressure deep-crust tremor detected
text: JMA has issued a preparatory watch. While no immediate surface displacement is expected in next 5 days, the signal is consistent with upcoming forecast models for the Kanto region. Regional hubs are syncing evacuation protocols.
summary: Deep seismic watch issued for Kanto.

title: Atmospheric Outlook: Early season tropical depression forming
text: NHC is monitoring a disturbance in the central Atlantic. Early models suggest a path towards the Florida straits. Upcoming forecast expected in next 5 days to confirm intensity. Logistics teams are auditing storm shutter inventories.
